queries.sql: SELECT `c`.`id` AS `cart_item_id`, `c`.`product_id`, `c`.`quantity`, `p`.`product_name`, `p`.`listing_price`, `p`.`mrp`, `p`.`stock_quantity`, `p`.`selling_price`, `p`.`shipping_allowance`, `p`.`min_order_quantity`, `p`.`status`, `p`.`approval_status`, `c`.`wow_offer_applied`, ( SELECT pi.image_path FROM ajobmart_product_images pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.is_primary DESC, pi.sort_order ASC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS image_path FROM `ajobmart_cart_items` `c` JOIN `ajobmart_products` `p` ON `p`.`id` = `c`.`product_id` WHERE `c`.`customer_id` = 20 ORDER BY `c`.`created_at` DESC
